questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '3'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a12a0b7b988513f39597edecaa6726e11bb71ecac511e5236e4beccfda289a1.png]
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes taking figure 1 and figure 2 ,the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 3 is common on both figure 1 and figure 2, it is clear that 2, 4, 5 and 6 are adjacent to it and remaining number i.e., 1 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce815b638c7e0427ec435d019f5c16bec5e1324fb86f921ad51e1c167335d047.png] 

Opposite pairs:

4 → 5

2 → 6

1 → 3

So, the opposite side of "3" will be side "1".

Hence, the correct answer is "1".

questions.question: Seven people, P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only four people sit to the right of P. Only two people sit between P and S. Q is sitting third to the right of V. T is sitting second to the right of V. U is sitting third to the left of T. Who is sitting at the extreme right end of the row?
questions.solution:
**Given : **Seven people, P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

**Explanation :**

1) Only four people sit to the right of P.

2) Only two people sit between P and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/017b91458083e0a0c9f366b6fb8af619981555386dc5cae3df90e019cb389890.png] 

3) Q is sitting third to the right of V.

4) T is sitting second to the right of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2df185d856e78bc2c8062211e272d75516324bc778dee0de857f005a47f09b3d.png] 

5) U is sitting third to the left of T.

After positioning U only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d4ccb1d2574767511ca0462b64fa900651c938cd7ca5e3f9e464dbf5c9342a8.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement R is sitting at the extreme right end of the row.

Hence, **"R"** is the correct answer.

72 × 3 + 48 ÷ 6 - 16 = 296

Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All masks are sanitizers.

All handwashes are sanitizers.

All sanitizers are medicines.

**Conclusions:**

I. All handwashes are medicines.

II. All medicines are masks.

III. Some medicines are handwashes.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb8ee64f702be74cb392a111912c3560c6411698c6a52769e103fb3df43e0774.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All handwashes are medicines → Follow (As, all handwashes are sanitizers and all sanitizers are medicines. So, all handwashes are definitely medicines)

II. All medicines are masks → Dos not Follow (As, all masks are sanitizers and all sanitizers are medicines. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

III. Some medicines are handwashes → Follow (As, all handwashes are sanitizers and all sanitizers are medicines. So, Some medicines are handwashes)

So, Only conclusions I and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusions I and III follow**".

questions.question:
D $ E means ‘D is the daughter of E’

D @ E means ‘D is the mother of E’

D + E means ‘D is the father of E’

D * E means ‘D is the husband of E’

If P * T $ X + Z, then how is P related to Z?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
D is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
$

 
 
 
@

 
 
 
+

 
 *
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Father

 
 Husband
 
 

 
 
to E

 
 
 

Statement given : P * T $ X + Z

So,

 
• P * T → P is the husband of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9856f7ba293e5603e0920c15bd5772490dbf4d88a1ee02b89167e02928cd82b8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a80b5ceb98172d3aaa2018d469dbe17e9baedb929bdde44a21f20392d26414e.png] 

 
• T $ X → T is the daughter of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9036c0c90c464434ba4611a0836495e787ec5e909fe0262864e19ea499d7c3d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4b7e2a883e7bf8da5849147e6b412615c4ca0c777c442044cf57c64a76c39c1.png] 

 
• X + Z → X is the father of Z.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75fb4ce8fdc93bb4f178d70b142372bb183f1a3bd5c274fc785311b23fce1fd3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f44ba076fb870d87b06d295d5a190c8ae53ad769c753d6a4f9f6b42de849962.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree P is the brother-in-law i.e sister's husband of Z.

Hence, "**Sister’s husband**" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Six friends (Aman, Biplab, Chirantan, Divya, Elizabeth and Firoz) are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Aman sits third to the left of Biplab. Chirantan is an immediate neighbour of Aman. Elizabeth sits second to the right of Divya. Chirantan is not an immediate neighbour of Divya. Who sits to the immediate left of Biplab?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Six friends (Aman, Biplab, Chirantan, Divya, Elizabeth and Firoz) are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

**Explanation : **

1) Aman sits third to the left of Biplab.

2) Chirantan is an immediate neighbour of Aman.

As position of Chirantan is not known yet, therefore there are two possible positions for Chirantan.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95517fd712876db6b3ca2ba8494a6c4218420f1c091b3ae908f045866ea2606c.png] 

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8ab0b178ee8856430785bf89abcc89a376ab66bfd3c19d32eb7f5d587febcd6.png] 

3) Elizabeth sits second to the right of Divya.

4) Chirantan is not an immediate neighbour of Divya.

As there is possible position for Elizabeth in case - (1) considering the conditions given, therefore case - (1) is eliminated.

After positioning Divya and Elizabeth only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Firoz.

 
• Case - (2) : 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97ecd1d7016e23a09a8f4ebf8c1e23897180fd384af05bbde8f8146f5725633b.png] ​

Thus, according to the final arrangement Divya sits to the immediate left of Biplab.

Hence, **"Divya"** is the correct answer.
